Vitafilter Premium Oil Filter

Your engine's first line of defence

Vitafilter is a premium automobile oil filter, made in our factory in Ogun State. It traps over 90% of particles 5 microns and larger, and every box carries a QR code that proves it's genuine.

Explore the range Check a filter is genuine

What makes it premium

Engineered to keep grit out of your engine for longer.

Advanced filtration
Multi-layer synthetic media filters down to 5 microns, with over 90% efficiency on particles that size and larger.
Durable construction
A heavy-duty housing and anti-drain-back valve, built to withstand high static and dynamic oil pressure.
Extended lifespan
Longer service intervals, rated for over 10,000 miles in service.
Tested at every stage
Filter paper, finished filters and every production run are checked before they leave our factory.

Which type does your engine take?

Check your old filter. If it's a paper element inside a housing, you need a cartridge. If it's a sealed can that screws on, you need a spin-on.

Premium cartridge filters

An element with no metal parts that fits inside a fixed canister on the engine. P series and HK series.

See cartridge filters

Premium spin-on filters

A metal housing with a threaded sealing plate that screws straight onto the engine. V001, V002 and V003.

See spin-on filters

Fake filters look the same until they fail

A counterfeit filter can let grit reach your engine. Take ten seconds to check yours before you fit it.

  1. Find the QR code on the boxIt's printed on the Vitafilter packaging.
  2. Scan it with your phone cameraA genuine filter opens our genuine product page.
  3. No code, or the page doesn't open?Don't fit it. Tell us where you bought it and we'll follow up.

Our mission

To manufacture high-quality oil filters that represent value and conform to international standards, and to meet the needs of the automobile industry.

Quality assurance

Every Vitafilter is tested from raw material to finished product.

Raw materials

  • Filter paper burst strength
  • Porosity
  • Permeability

Production

  • Leakage testing
  • Bubble testing

Performance

  • Filtration efficiency
  • Dust count
  • Static and oscillating pressure
